the bell rule: down means 0.32 m (Castle Sound's number, its bricks are the same 0.30 m ones so its units are metres); a piece moved means 0.20 m (a brick width)
the bell is in reach of a big rod (an arc exists)
a big rod volley aimed at the bell drops it (Bell down after 1 rods)
the score counts shots, moved and standing, and they add up
replay: the same fort rebuilt and the same shots fed again give the same hash at the same step, and the bell falls again
replay keeps the event log (1 events)

Rebuild resets the score (0 moved, bell up, no shots)
the same three rods give the same hash and the same moved count in two fresh sessions
